message: さすらいのアルバイター

name: Synn
message: 「I'm so excited for the welcome party!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get too carried away. You've been fidgeting since yesterday.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just because I'm restless after quitting my part-time job.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a troublesome workaholic streak.」
「Yah, toh!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hm...? Hey, Demon Lord, what's that over there?」
「Yo, hup, hah...」
Beyond the crowd, a girl was hopping up and down.
「Nn, hmph, just a little more...!」
Wielding a massive blade ill-suited for her small frame, she was poking at a shopfront sign.

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't seen her around before. Wonder what she's doing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Beats me. She's dressed in some pretty tacky clothes, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Swinging around a kitchen knife that big in the middle of town is dangerous.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, I don't think that's a kitchen knife...」

name: Paqy
message: （Still... that sword, where have I...）

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, isn't it that, Paqy?」
A ball was sitting on top of the sign the girl was poking at.

name: Synn
message: 「She's trying to get that down.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a reckless kid.」
「Nngh, come on, get over here...!」
As if jumping weren't enough, the girl even started climbing up a streetlight.

name: Synn
message: 「She's so close, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's boring, so just leave her alone.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you talking about! She's a good kid trying to take care of her things!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-You think so...?」

name: Synn
message: 「...All right, let's help her out!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. Sheesh, you're way too soft-hearted, Demon Lord」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, what're you gonna do about that thing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, just leave it to me」

name: Synn
message: 「Believe it or not, I get called in as a ringer for the neighborhood sandlot baseball tournament a lot, so I'm pretty confident in my control」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-H-Hey, Demon Lord! What do you think you're doing grabbing me like that!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm counting on you, Paqy. Hyah!」
I wind up big and throw him!

name: Paqy
message: 「Uhyoaaa~~~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gweh!」
A clean hit right onto the ball on top of the sign!
「Ah, i-it--I got i~t!」
Having been knocked just out of place, the nudged ball rolls down right in front of the girl.
「Alri~ght! Way to go, me! I can do it when I try!」
「Oh, here, I got your ball back!」
「Next time, you have to play somewhere wider, okay?」
The girl smiled warmly as she handed the ball over to the neighborhood kids who had gathered around.

name: Synn
message: 「I see, she was trying to get those kids' ball down for them...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. That kindness and indomitable fighting spirit! As Student Council President, I ought to follow her example」
Watching the kids off, the girl's back looked small, yet dependable.
「Phew! That's one job done!」
「What I've gained is popularity! And hope for the future! Yep, those are super important things!」
「No~w then, what kind of job is next!?」
「Aww... I'm hungry...」
「Whoa!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good work out there. Want some milk if you'd like?」
「Y-You scared me~. Who are you, mister?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mister?」
「Yeah. 'Cause you're a guy who's taller than me, so you're mister」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I see」
「Oh, wait--were you actually a miss?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope, you got it right, you got it right! Mister is fine」
「Thought so!」
「So... what's that white stuff? Poison?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's Milky milk」
「Milky milk~?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's super tasty and good for your body. Go ahead and drink up」
「Really? It's kinda lukewarm though, is it okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Totally fine. Milk tastes best at body temperature」
「Is that so...?」
「Um, well then... thanks for the drink」
「Gulp, gulp, gulp...」
「Phew!」

name: Synn
message: 「How is it?」
「Yummy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
「This is so good! I'm moved!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right? Want another one if you'd like?」
「Huh, really? Even though I didn't do anything...」

name: Synn
message: 「Go right ahead. The world runs on helping each other out, after all」
「Helping each other out...」
「Come to think of it, was it you who helped get that ball earlier, mister?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, it wasn't any big deal」

name: Synn
message: 「Working hard for the good of society and others is only natural as the Student Council president」
Well, half of it was Paqy's hard work, though.
「Student Council, president...? Are you someone important, mister?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Not important, exactly, more like everyone's representative, I guess」
「Ooh!」

name: Synn
message: 「And I make everyone's school life sparkle!」
「I see!」
「I feel like I just ran into someone amazing right after getting here...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you move here recently?」
「Mm, well, something like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is that right」
「All right, I can't let you beat me, mister! I've gotta hurry up and find a job!」

name: Synn
message: 「A job--like, are you looking for a part-time gig?」
「Pretty much」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, I actually have an idea」
「Huh, really!? Wait, no, no, I can't just keep relying on other people!」
「In order to make the power of the great Macaron known, I have to handle what I can do on my own!」

name: Synn
message: 「So your name is Macaron. I'm Synn Sakura. Nice to meet you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, nice to meet you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Think you'll be okay looking for a part-time job?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? U-Umm, with my skills, it'll be a piece of cake, probably……」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-I mean, I was already doing labor just now anyway……」

name: Synn
message: 「By labor, you mean things like fetching balls for kids?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Plus, I also carried luggage for the elderly and rescued a kitty from a tree, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How kind of you……!」
Anyone who appreciates how delicious milk is can't be a bad person!

name: Synn
message: 「Won't you let me introduce you to a workplace after all?」
Looking for a part-time job at Macaron's age--there must be some kind of family circumstances behind it.
Knowing all too well how hard that is, I can't help wanting to lend her a hand.

name: Macaron
message: 「But……」

name: Synn
message: 「You want to find one yourself?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Of course! One must choose the path one ought to walk on one's own!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, then how about this. Since you're a newcomer to the Ryusei Shopping District, I'll show you around the street」

name: Macaron
message: 「Show me around?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. After that, you can decide where you want to work, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see. Well, if that's all, I guess…… that's fine」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you're going that far, I'll take you up on it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, leave it to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「―And that over there is my childhood friend's house, a soba restaurant called Yuugiri―an」

name: Macaron
message: 「Soba. Soba noodles, yeah, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「The soba at Nanaka's place is super tasty, an absolute delicacy」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm... Is it better than milk?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ummm... I feel like Nanaka would get mad at me if I compared them」

name: Macaron
message: 「Really? So soba and milk don't go well together, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though they're both so good」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's that shop over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, that's a cake shop」

name: Synn
message: 「Apparently Nanaka's a regular there, though I can't really tell the difference between it and other shops」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, and then next is...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Hey, big brother, are you and that Nanaka person close?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Well, we're childhood friends, so I think we are. Why?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nothing. You've been bringing up her name a lot, so I just felt like asking」

name: Synn
message: 「Have I?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You have」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I didn't even notice」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, isn't it normal to get along well with all of your friends?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then, what about me... will you get along well with me too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course! We can't have anyone left out of a sparkling academy life, after all」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see, I see. Ehehe... then never mind」

name: Synn
message: 「Never mind what?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nothing at all」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, hey, hey, what's that shop over there? Something smells really good!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's the Five-Star Restaurant.」

name: Synn
message: 「Once I grow up a little more and become a charismatic president, I should be able to treat you there!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother... are you aiming to be charismatic?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... I mean to, yeah.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then I definitely won't lose to you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Yeah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「No matter how nice you are, Big Brother, this is the one thing I won't back down on!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is that really something you compete over?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「If it means I can't get along with someone, I don't even need to become one.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-Is that right... hehe. Well, if you say so, then it's fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「You really give everything your all, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? I-It's not like that's anything special, obviously! Come on, let's hurry up and go to the next place!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
I wonder if she was being considerate of my wallet.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's roughly the gist of it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Thanks, Big Brother. I feel like you showed me around so much...」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry about it, don't worry about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, and one more piece of advice--if you're looking for a part-time job, I'd recommend the Amakawa Milk Shop.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaah, what's that supposed to mean?! Do you think I can be lured in with milk?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you hate milk?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I love it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「A-Anyway, whether I take the part-time job or not is a whole different story, got it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, stop laughing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. Good luck with the part-time job. I'm rooting for you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah. Thanks...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, I'd hate to keep you out late, so I'm gonna head off now」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sorry for dragging you around to so many things today」

name: Synn
message: 「We're in this together when times get tough. Don't worry about it」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe, I guess so」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then next time you're in trouble, Big Brother, I'll be the one to help you out! That's a promise!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh-ho」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I just let you take care of me all the time, it'd ruin the great Macaron's reputation」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. I'll be counting on you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Leave it to me!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, Big Brother, thanks for today! See ya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bye-bye」
As I watched Macaron's retreating figure grow smaller and smaller...
For some reason, I couldn't help feeling like I shouldn't leave her on her own.

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, I ought to head home soon too...」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I'm forgetting something...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heeey, Demon Looord~...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Paqy. What are you doing over there」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'm hungry, so let's hurry up and head back」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Being the Demon Lord's servant sure is tough...」
